message: Linking rows now needs read access to the linked table
bullet_points: Database tokens and roles without read access to the linked table get a 401 when they set link row values, including resending existing links or removing one of several. Clearing the field still works.
The same applies to `__join`, file imports, Application Builder and automation actions, and default values of personal views.
Saving a link row default value on a view needs read access to the linked table. Collaborative and restricted views then apply it to every new row.
